sections: About this site
SoloStarter HQ (solostarterhq.com) is an independent affiliate marketing website. Its purpose is to promote the free plan of systeme.io, an online business platform, to freelancers.
We earn money as a systeme.io affiliate. If you create a systeme.io account through a link on this site and later buy a paid plan, systeme.io pays us a commission. You pay the same price either way.
SoloStarter HQ is not systeme.io. It is not run, sponsored or endorsed by systeme.io or by ITACWT Limited, which operates systeme.io. systeme.io is a trade mark of its owner.

Information only
Everything on this site is general information. It is not financial, legal, tax or business advice.
Plan details come from systeme.io's own website and were checked in October 2026. systeme.io can change its plans, limits and prices at any time, so check its pricing page before you decide.
The figures in the calculator are examples, not real prices. Any saving depends on the tools and prices you enter.
We do not promise any income, results or savings.
Links to other websites
Sign-up links take you to systeme.io's website. Your account, any purchase and your use of systeme.io are between you and systeme.io, under its own terms and privacy policy.
We are not responsible for the content of other websites.
Our liability
We work to keep this site accurate, but we provide it as it is, without any guarantee that it is complete, up to date or free from errors.
As far as the law allows, we are not liable for any loss arising from your use of this site or of websites it links to.

Nothing on this page limits liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud, or for anything else that the law does not allow us to limit. Your statutory rights as a consumer are not affected.
Privacy
Who is responsible: {NAME} (SoloStarterHQ), at the address above, is the data controller for this website. Contact: {EMAIL}.
What this site collects: it has no cookies, contact forms, accounts or tracking pixels, and its fonts are stored on the site itself.

Visit statistics: we use Umami Cloud (Umami Software, Inc., USA) to count page visits and clicks on the sign-up buttons. Umami uses no cookies, does not follow you across other websites, and we only see anonymous totals, such as how many people clicked a button on the Spanish page. To count a visit, your browser sends Umami your IP address and browser details, which Umami says it anonymises; Umami stores the statistics in its EU region, and some of its service providers are in the USA. We rely on our legitimate interest in knowing which pages help visitors. If your browser sends a Do Not Track signal, no statistics are recorded.

Hosting: the site is hosted on GitHub Pages by GitHub, Inc. (USA). When you visit, GitHub logs your IP address and technical details of the request to deliver the pages and keep them secure. We rely on our legitimate interest in running a secure website. GitHub is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and its UK extension; see GitHub's privacy statement for details.

Affiliate links: when you click a sign-up button, you go to systeme.io with our affiliate code in the link, so that systeme.io can credit us. From then on, systeme.io (ITACWT Limited, Ireland) decides what data it collects, under its own privacy policy. To pay commissions, systeme.io may show us limited details of accounts created through our link. We use these only to check commissions and keep tax records, and we keep them for up to 6 years.

Your rights: under UK and EU data protection law, and Brazil's LGPD, you can ask us to give you a copy of your personal data, correct it or delete it, or to restrict or stop how we use it. Email us to do so. You can also complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk) or to the data protection authority where you live.
Changes and applicable law
We may update this page. The date below shows the current version.
This website is run from England, and the law of England and Wales applies. If you are a consumer, you keep the protection of the mandatory laws of the country where you live.
